description: Test file for absl::FastTypeId, including various type identity tests for primitive, fixed-width, alias, and template types, as well as inheritance scenarios.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.PrimitiveTypes
methods.description: Test for primitive type IDs, ensuring each type has a unique ID and matches itself.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.FixedWidthTypes
methods.description: Test for fixed-width integer type IDs, ensuring each type has a unique ID and matches itself.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.AliasTypes
methods.description: Test for type aliasing, ensuring alias type IDs match the original type IDs.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.TemplateSpecializations
methods.description: Test for template specialization type IDs, ensuring different template instantiations have different IDs.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.Inheritance
methods.description: Test for inheritance relationships, ensuring base and derived types have different IDs.
